incidents.title: BlueNoroff's GhostCall and GhostHire campaigns sped up by generative AI
incidents.targets: Web3 and crypto executives and blockchain developers
incidents.outcome: macOS users lured by fake venture-capital calls and fake recruiter tests.
incidents.confidenceReason: Kaspersky states the AI use; it reaches us through AI Threat Watch.
incidents.summary: Kaspersky says BlueNoroff used generative AI to speed malware development and to analyze stolen data for targeting in GhostCall (fake VC calls on macOS) and GhostHire (fake recruiter tests), active since April 2025.
incidents.quote: Kaspersky said BlueNoroff used generative AI to speed malware development and analyse stolen data for targeting in GhostCall (fake VC calls on macOS) and GhostHire (fake recruiter tests), active since April 2025.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only Kaspersky has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep, which AI Threat Watch restates.

incidents.title: Millions of dollars stolen through Giselle Bundchen deepfake scam
incidents.actor: Fraud ring (four arrested by Brazilian police)
incidents.outcome: About $3.9 million in fake shipping fees, per police.
incidents.confidenceReason: Brazilian police charged the use of deepfake videos; it reaches us through Forbes.
incidents.summary: Brazilian police arrested four people over Instagram ads using deepfake videos of Gisele Bundchen to sell 'free' products for shipping fees.
incidents.quote: Brazilian police recently arrested four people charging them with using deepfake videos of supermodel Gisele Bundchen in advertisements for “free” anti-wrinkle creams and suitcases for which customers merely had to pay shipping fees.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only Forbes has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

incidents.title: RevengeHotels campaign uses LLM-generated infector code and lures against Latin America
incidents.targets: Hotels and travel in Latin America
incidents.outcome: Hotels in Latin America received VenomRAT through the campaign.
incidents.confidenceReason: Kaspersky says much of the infector code appears LLM-generated; an inference from the code.
incidents.summary: Kaspersky reports that a significant portion of the initial infector and downloader code in a RevengeHotels campaign against Latin American hotels appears to be written by LLM agents. The date is approximate.
incidents.quote: A significant portion of the initial infector and downloader code in this campaign appears to be generated by large language model (LLM) agents.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only Kaspersky has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.
